verdict.rationale: Trilegal is documented as an India-only firm (offices only in Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, NCR, Pune, GIFT City) with content limited to India-specific instruments (DPDPA, ESOP-buyback tax analysis, Indian FDI/GenAI policy). There is no evidence of publications on UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, or French BSPCE, so the cross-border jurisdictional coverage the story requires is unevidenced.
